Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:
CUNCTATOR MOTION: MADISON

Sponsored by the Madison Elder Kindred Network and White Wolf, Inc

DATE
Sunday, November 18th, 2001. Registration starts at 11am, we will try to begin
at Noon.

FORMAT
This is a *FREE* V:EKN sanctioned (constructed) tournament! See
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/veknRules.html for further details. Three 2-hour
rounds for qualifying, with a 5-player 2-hour final.

PRIZE SUPPORT
Prizes include Sabbat War packs + V:TES starters for the finalists. Also, every
player attending the tournament will receive a special Cunctator Motion
"foil"-type card! A Madison special!

LOCATION
The tournament will be held at the University of Wisconsin Student Union at 800
Langdon Street, in Madison, Wisconsin. (I suggest http://www.MapQuest.com for
directions.) When you get inside the Union, the main board has a TODAY IN THE
UNION sign posted where you can look for our room under "Madison Elder Kindred
Network".

PARKING
There is a close-up map of the downtown campus at
http://www.union.wisc.edu/images/mupark.gif. I suggest parking in the LAKE
STREET RAMP and just walking over to the Union, since that ramp is usually $1
for the whole day on weekends.

FOOD
The Union has a bar, a buffet-type restaurant, and an ice cream/munchies
counter. There is also a McDonald's, Taco Bell, Burger King, Starbucks, Pizza
Hut, and 14 bars within 4 blocks. =)

Remember to bring all your trade stuff. In Madison, we live to trade, and we
trade to live.

Kevin M., Prince of Madison, WI (USA)
